description: Authorize the quoted price and queue conversion. Optional account document conversion. Check conversion_limits in get_base before upload. Raw HTTP accepts application/pdf, application/msword or application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document with URL-encoded X-Document-Name, up to 8 MiB. PDF permits 200 physical pages. DOC and DOCX contain continuous text, with pages=0 and no visual review; their quote charges once per file. The product publishes its rates in /api/pricing. JSON: filename and canonical file_base64; prefer raw HTTP for large files. The MCP transport permits 256 KiB per request. Upload only obtains a quote. Authorize with the exact quote and explicit user authority to spend credit. A repeated authorization reuses the account's right for this source hash. Processing continues without an open browser. Publication remains a separate action.

authorize.description: Must be true. Requires explicit user authority to spend the quoted credit.
